teaser: A debate picked up for sport can still land somewhere true. That is the shape of a 2 who is also an ENTP: a peacemaker's instinct for what holds a room together, wired through a mind that would rather test every side of an idea than settle on one. The 2 wants harmony; the ENTP wants friction, the kind that sharpens thought. In you, the friction often becomes the way harmony gets built — you argue your way toward agreement rather than arriving at it quietly. It makes you a strange, useful kind of mediator: one who picks the fight apart before offering to end it.
excerpt: A key left in the ignition of a car in a trailhead parking lot, because the conversation in the front seat was not done yet.
